name: Shoko MPC-HC
overview: Play episodes in MPC-HC directly from the Shoko Web UI. Includes one-time Windows link-handler setup.

releases.release_notes: TV casting settings now live on the MPC-HC setup page, because current Shoko Web UI versions have no editor for plugin settings. Administrators can enter the agent URL, LAN base URL and agent secret there; the secret is never shown back. No Windows Setup update needed.
